prompt: Build a taskr list command with dual-mode output (table for humans, JSON for scripts) for a Task struct with id, title, status, due_date, priority.

assertions.text: Has a generic table formatter function (print_table or equivalent)
Routes to JSON when --json is set, table otherwise (dual-mode output)
Has a hint/next-steps function that prints suggestions to stderr
Table output is borderless (no +, |, or --- border characters)
Formats due_date for human readability (not raw ISO/Debug)
Has a type-specific renderer function for Tasks (not generic JSON dump)
